description: N64-era sequenced/low-memory aesthetic, not console emulation. Original synthesized material only.

conventions.dynamics: tanh soft saturation, RMS target with peak-limited gain; no hard clipping
conventions.reverb: three early reflection taps, circular on loops; maximum tap 216 ms at default
conventions.filter: two gentle one-pole low passes around internal quantization
conventions.loop: periodic generators and circular tails; fixed-origin short Hermite boundary bridge, no endpoint fade or timeline rotation
conventions.music: five shared-clock sequenced stems; original motifs, GM-labelled MIDI, synthetic instruments
conventions.loudness: 20 log10(unweighted RMS full scale), not LUFS/BS.1770 or true peak
